name: Potion Brewers Guild
description: Weekly brewing sessions where members experiment with rare ingredients and compete in seasonal potion contests.

name: Advanced Transmutation
description: Theory and practice of turning one substance into another, from base metals to living tissue.

name: Dueling Circle
description: Supervised one-on-one dueling practice with ranked tournaments every term.

name: Ward Crafting Seminar
description: Designing protective wards for buildings and people, including layered and self-repairing barriers.

name: Infirmary Volunteers
description: Assist the school healers with minor injuries and learn first-response spellwork.

name: Restorative Magic
description: Advanced healing: regrowing bone, purging curses and treating magical exhaustion.

name: Familiar Keepers
description: Care for the school's magical creatures and learn to bond with a familiar.

name: Summoning Theory
description: The binding circles, contracts and safety protocols behind summoning other-planar beings.

name: Expedition Society
description: Weekend expeditions to the enchanted forest and nearby ruins, mapping and cataloguing magical sites.

name: Ancient Runes Study Group
description: Members translate runic texts from the library archives together and present their findings.

name: Battle Alchemy
description: Explosive and defensive concoctions for field use, taught under strict safety rules.

name: Skyward Broom Racing
description: Competitive broom racing team with training flights three times a week.

name: Defensive Tactics Workshop
description: Team-based scenarios defending against curses, creatures and ambushes.

name: Community Spellcraft
description: Members use their magic for village projects: mending bridges, purifying wells and helping at the market.

name: Arcane Research Fellowship
description: Independent research project supervised by a faculty mentor, ending in a published thesis.
